import numpy as np
from netnomos.engine import mask_to_int, int_to_mask, lowest_bit
for n in [1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65, 100, 1000, 65536]:
    for seed in range(5):
        rng = np.random.default_rng(seed * 1000 + n)
        a = rng.integers(0, 2, size=n).astype(bool)
        v = mask_to_int(a)
        assert v == sum(int(x) << i for i, x in enumerate(a)) or n > 2000, (n, seed)
        b = int_to_mask(v, n)
        assert (b == a).all(), (n, seed)
        if v:
            assert lowest_bit(v) == int(np.argmax(a))
print('mask helpers OK')

# lexicographic prefix ranges behave like startswith over digit spellings
import bisect, random
AFTER = ':'
rng = random.Random(0)
for trial in range(300):
    vals = sorted(set(rng.randrange(0, 1000001) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 40))))
    spell = sorted(str(v) for v in vals)
    for _ in range(20):
        p = ''.join(rng.choice('0123456789') for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 7)))
        lo = bisect.bisect_left(spell, p)
        hi = bisect.bisect_left(spell, p + AFTER)
        got = spell[lo:hi]
        want = [s for s in spell if s.startswith(p)]
        assert got == want, (p, got, want)
print('prefix ranges OK')
